cs.t: Well, I didn't have a good experience with NVIDIA even though it's been a great brand to me when I used a PC many years ago. The NVIDIA 8800 in my Mac Pro was a miserable failure, and neither NVIDIA or Apple would RMA it even though I had on record multiple complaints about spotty behavior before it completely failed. I read lots of complaints on the Apple forums, and not just about this particular card.
cs.th: Apple ditches NVIDIA, goes with ATI for their desktop lineup
